App.Title: TekuTeku File Merge
Action.ReverseHint: Flips the list top to bottom. The last file becomes the first.
List.DropHintSub: or use Add files / Add folder. Drag rows to set the merge order.
List.Column.Name: Name
Options.Title: Options
Options.Binary.Note: Files are appended byte for byte with nothing added or changed. Check the order carefully: a wrong order produces a corrupt file.
Options.FallbackEncodingHint: Used when a file has no BOM and is not valid UTF-8.
Options.EnsureTrailingNewline: Add a line break to files that do not end with one
Options.SkipRepeatedHeader: Skip the header row of every file after the first
Options.SkipRepeatedHeaderHint: For CSV and TSV files that repeat their column names.
Options.TrimTrailingBlankLines: Remove blank lines at the end of each file
Options.RemoveInnerBoms: Remove the byte order mark from files after the first
Plan.Preserve: Files will be joined byte for byte. Nothing is converted.
Plan.Transform: Files will be read as text and rewritten using the options below.
Detect.SplitArchive: Split archive parts detected. They will be joined byte for byte.
Folder.Title: Add folder
Folder.FilterHint: Separate multiple patterns with a semicolon, for example *.log; *.txt
Output.Label: Save merged file to
Output.Placeholder: Choose where to save the result
Result.Title: Merge complete
Error.NoInput: Add at least one file first.
Error.NoOutput: Choose where to save the merged file.
Error.OutputIsInput: The output file is also one of the input files. Choose a different name.
Error.EncodingGuessed: Encoding could not be determined with certainty; {0} was assumed.
